newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 133-day BBCs at 2.208 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 133-day BBCs at 2.208 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 1.399 billion reais of 133-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight rate of 2.208 percent a month, dealers said.
The rate at the bank's weekly formal bond auction was slightly up from 2.204 percent at last week's sale.
The Central Bank also sold 2.266 billion reais in 182-day BBCs at an overnight rate of 2.281 percent a month, up from 2.257 percent last week.
The financial result of the auction indicated 335 million reais will be added to the banking system as 4.0 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
